Sets the pending shape: a rectangle in surface-local logical coordinates, with up to four independent corner radii, that the effect is clipped and shaped to. If w or h is zero or negative, the shape is ignored (unset behavior). A negative radius is treated as zero. Radii are clamped the same way as CSS border-radius.

Sets one pending custom effect stage: its position in the layer's ordered effect stack (`stack_index`, the absolute index module implementing the effect ABI (the client prepends the ABI definitions; the module defines exactly `fn apply(...) -> EffectCtx` plus any helpers it needs), packed little-endian f32 uniforms (whole vec4s only), which backdrop texture the only; 0 elsewhere). Indices may arrive in any order; the executor sorts by index. A duplicate index replaces the earlier pending stage at that index. The whole set is cleared by `clear_effects`, which the client sends at the head of every commit's batch, so a shrinking stack can never leak stale stages across commits. Out-of-range or misaligned payloads are ignored per-request — hints never raise protocol errors.
Drops every pending effect stage for the next commit's apply. Sent at the head of each commit's batch so the latched set always mirrors the current stack exactly.
